description: For native formulas \(C,D,E\), a supplied stability construction for \(E\), an intuitionistic raw derivation of \(\neg\neg(C\lor D)\) from \(\Gamma\), and supplied raw branches deriving \(E\) from \(\Gamma,C\) and \(\Gamma,D\), give an actual raw derivation of \(E\) from \(\Gamma\), in the same logical-equality mode.
